description: a cylinder r 0.5, h 1 along x lying on a 10 × 10 × 1 plate's bottom face, cut from the plate: the touch is the cylinder's seam, since an axis along +x puts the seam at +z, on the side against the face. The cut is the plate, untouched (the touch shares no material): the touch along the seam is a contact as one off it is, and the seam no image on the face. Turned by 1e-9 of a radian about z, off the seam, it builds the same. Found by boolean_prop's a_cylinder_tangent_to_a_box_face_leaves_the_box_and_shares_nothing at 5000 cases on the fixed seed, which draws the angle 0 exactly (plans/measuring-harness step 6; fixed by plans/split-by-plane step 4)
